message.content: {"forecasts":[{"quote":"Once lockers are live at the five busiest transit stops, failed first-time deliveries will drop by a third within two quarters."},{"quote":"Recipients will collect parcels more often on weekdays because the lockers sit on their commute."},{"quote":"We expect that merchants who offer locker pickup are likely to see fewer \"where is my order\" contacts."},{"quote":"Competing couriers are expected to copy the locker model within a year of our launch."}]}
